SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 3777
Date 17 / 6 / 32

June 17, 32.

CONFIDENTIAL

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of your
letter, C.P.C.No.80/1924 of June 7, 1932 and in reply
to inform you that there is nothing in our records
detrimental to the character of Walter Schmuchow.

Inquiries show that Schmuchow, an aeronautical
engineer by profession arrived in Shanghai in the latter
part of 1930 and joined the "Icarus Aero Supply Company",
320 Kiangse Road, a German firm engaged in importing
aeroplanes and other war material for the Chinese National
Government. He resided in Shanghai until March, 1932
when he left for South China.

He is not very well known in the German community,
due to the shortness of his residence in Shanghai, but it
is said that he has a good reputation.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Sd) K. M. Bourne.
Deputy Commissioner (Crime).

Inspector General of Police,
Police Headquarters,
Hongkong.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处
编号 D 3777
日期 1932年6月17日

1932年6月17日。

机密

先生：

谨此确认收到阁下1932年6月7日来函，编号C.P.C.No.80/1924，并回复告知，我局档案中并无任何不利于沃尔特·施穆乔（Walter Schmuchow）品行的记录。

经查，施穆乔系航空工程师，于1930年末抵达上海，加入位于江西路320号的“伊卡洛斯航空供应公司”（Icarus Aero Supply Company）。这是一家德国商行，从事为中国国民政府进口飞机及其他军用物资的业务。他在上海居住至1932年3月，随后前往华南地区。

由于在上海居住时间较短，他在德侨社区中并不广为人知，但据称其声誉良好。

谨此致意，
先生，
您忠实的仆人，

（签名）K. M. 伯恩
副总监（刑事）

警察总监，
警察总部，
香港。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

File No.
H.Q.C.B. Station,
Date June 17, 1932

Subject (in full) Walter Schwuchow

Made by D.S.I. Ovsiannikoff Forwarded by Supt. Quayle

Sir,
With reference to the attached confidential letter C.P.O.
No. 80/1924 from the Hongkong Police, dated June 7th, 1932 re
Walter Schwuchow, German citizen, enquiries go to show that he
arrived in Shanghai from Germany some time in the end of 1930
and being aeronautical engineer by profession joined the local
German firm named "Icarus Aero Supply Company", 320 Kiangse
Road, which was dealing in importation of various war materials
for the National Government including aeroplanes and parts for
the same.
Walter Schwuchow, since his arrival in Shanghai till Septem-
ber 20th, 1931, lived in various private houses in the Settlement
and French Concession and then he removed to the Plaza Hotel,
where he stayed till March 14th, 1932 and then left for South
of China with intent to further his business in war materials.
It appears that after his trip to the South of China he intended
to return to Shanghai as he retained his room in the Plaza Hotel
and also left his heavy baggage there. About a month ago he
sent a telegram to the manager of the Plaza Hotel requesting him
to cancel the retention of the room, but nothing said about the
baggage. It is reported that he is very little known among the
local German community on account of his short stay in Shanghai
but nevertheless it is said that he is of good character and
bears a good reputation. There is nothing detrimental known to
the Police regarding him.

I am, Sir,
Forwarded. Yours obediently,
In Quayle V. Ovsiannikoff
Supt: D.S.I.
16. 6. 32.
D.C.(Crime)

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

报告

档案编号
总部刑事侦缉处，
日期 1932年6月17日

事由（全称） 沃尔特·施武乔（Walter Schwuchow）

制作人：侦探副督察 奥夫相尼科夫 转呈人：巡官 奎尔

先生：

关于附上的香港警方1932年6月7日发出的机密信函（编号C.P.O. No. 80/1924），涉及德国公民沃尔特·施武乔一事，经查询显示，他于1930年底某时从德国抵达上海，以其航空工程师的职业身份，加入了位于江西路320号的当地德国商行“伊卡洛斯航空供应公司”，该公司经营为国民政府进口包括飞机及其零部件在内的各种军用物资的业务。

沃尔特·施武乔自抵达上海至1931年9月20日期间，居住在公共租界和法租界的各处私人住宅，随后搬入普尔曼酒店（Plaza Hotel），一直住到1932年3月14日，之后前往中国南方，意图进一步开展其军用物资业务。

看来在他中国南方之行后，曾打算返回上海，因为他保留了在普尔曼酒店的房间，并将重型行李留在那里。约一个月前，他致电普尔曼酒店经理，要求取消保留房间，但未提及行李事宜。据报道，由于在上海停留时间短，他在当地德侨社区中鲜为人知，但尽管如此，据说他品行端正，声誉良好。警方方面未发现有关他的任何不利记录。

先生，
谨此转呈。您忠实的仆人，
V. 奥夫相尼科夫
侦探副督察
1932年6月16日。
副总监（刑事）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 2774
Date 17 / 6 / 32

G. [徽章] R.

No.
NUMBER AND DATE SHOULD
BE QUOTED IN REFERENCE
TO THIS LETTER.

POLICE HEADQUARTERS,
HONG KONG.

STRICTLY CONFIDENTIAL.
7th June 1932.

C.P.O. No.80/1924.

Sir,

WALTER SCHWUCIOW (German subject)
(American citizenship applied for).

I have the honour to inform you that the above-
mentioned has recently opened a Company here styling itself
"The Progress Company". The Company has the intention of
supplying the various Chinese Provincial Governments in the
South with aeroplanes, machine guns, and arms and ammunition.

The above-mentioned German subject has stated to
this Department that from November 1930 to January 1932 he
was in charge of the Icarus Aero Supply Co., Ltd., in Shanghai,
which is now in voluntary liquidation.

I should be much obliged if you would inform me,
if the above-mentioned came to the notice of the Police while
he was in Shanghai, and if he is of good character and bears
a good reputation.

Syst C 1.
Refer plan.
Karl Barnes
D. C. (CRIME)
13 JUNE 1932

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

[签名]
p. Inspector General of Police.

The Deputy Commissioner of Crime,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

G. [徽章] R.

编号
引用此信时请注明
编号及日期。

警察总部，
香港。

绝密。
1932年6月7日。

C.P.O. 编号 80/1924。

先生：

沃尔特·施武乔（WALTER SCHWUCIOW）（德国籍）
（已申请美国国籍）。

谨此告知，上述人员近期在此开设了一家公司，名为“进步公司”（The Progress Company）。该公司意图向中国南方各省政府供应飞机、机枪及武器弹药。

上述德国籍人士向本部门陈述，1930年11月至1932年1月期间，他负责管理上海的伊卡洛斯航空供应有限公司（Icarus Aero Supply Co., Ltd.），该公司目前正在进行自愿清算。

如蒙告知上述人员在沪期间是否曾引起警方注意，以及其品行是否端正、声誉是否良好，本人将不胜感激。

Syst C 1.
参考计划。
卡尔·巴恩斯
副总监（刑事）
1932年6月13日

谨此致意，
先生，
您忠实的仆人，

[签名]
代 警察总监。

刑事副总监，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。
